name: Arroz con Leche
description: Creamy Mexican rice pudding cooked with cinnamon stick and lemon peel in whole milk until thick and fragrant.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with neutral vegetable oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the white rice and ground cinnamon until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the pickled red onions with the orange juice until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 35 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with epazote or a dusting of salsa verde.
Slice or portion into servings and serve.
tips: This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
